panels.description: Full-page Nexus fracture. The support corridor buckles as blue ice splits the wall and a metal brace crashes down. Roman receives one selective directional warning from his bonded TJ and pulls Sitara clear; Nayah redirects them along the marked route while meltwater spreads. Through a fractured window, emergency light reveals an empty krill tank and dead sensor display. Leave a clear upper-left zone for the structural sound, left-center for Roman's command, lower-left for Nayah's command, and right-center for impact sound.
